newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.150 cent. Look for increased packer interest on fed cattle to fill slaughter needs.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Firm tone to fed cattle market should keep interest for feeders strong.
HOGS - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Steady to higher live calls and technically strong after recent new highs.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.250 cent. Cash firm and light hog slaughter keeping storings low. Technically firm.
